paragraphs.text: The thundering beasts gain on you. But the pack is thinning out.

Make a CON roll for Norman, Sylvia, and yourself. Due to your 
long head start, you may each have a bonus die. If everyone succeeds, 
go to 344. If you fail, take 2D10 points of damage; if you somehow 
survive, go to 347. If you succeed but both Norman and Sylvia fail 
the roll, go to 356. If Norman alone fails it, go to 482. If Sylvia 
alone fails it, go to 520.
